meta.notes: Firmware before 1.4.15, where every preset holds 8 bands; otherwise as fosi-audio-ds3. Upsampling needs firmware 1.4.9 or later. Read on firmware 1.4.6: 10 presets, the 7 built-in ones (0 to 6) named by the device as listed ("CLASIC" sic; the web app shows Classic) and the user presets 7 to 9 (devicePEQ listed 7 to 11); each preset has its own pre-gain, which this firmware already has. The pre-gain range, -24 to 0 dB, was checked in the web app on 1.4.6.
